name: NBCU Finance Reporting Copilot Stack
description: Public demo-contract stack for a monthly-pacing finance reporting copilot: distinguishes a provisional carry-forward snapshot from a submitted-only roll-up, flags blocking exceptions (missing submissions, reconciliation gaps, cross-slide mismatches), and stages a draft review workbook and executive deck pending Finance approval.
features: Current Estimate vs Budget / Prior Year / Prior Pacing / Prior Estimate summary
Explicit provisional carry-forward versus submitted-only reporting status
Draft-until-approved review workbook and executive deck staging
benefits: Surfaces blocking review items before a package reaches Finance
Never coerces a missing submission to zero
Keeps generated outputs clearly marked draft until an owner approves them

components.name: nbcu_finance_reporting_demo_agent.py
components.description: Small standalone public demo agent returning the fixed, signed-off synthetic reporting snapshot used by this stack's demo. It intentionally does not implement workbook/PPTX generation, formula-signature governance, or Office file ingestion — that full engine is a private production package. This agent exists to keep the public demo's data contract versioned, deterministic, and honest about its own scope.

demo.title: NBCUniversal Finance Reporting Copilot Interactive Demo
demo.description: Scripted 3-turn Microsoft 365 Copilot-style demo: summarize Current Estimate vs Budget, show blocking exceptions and cross-slide controls, then stage a draft review workbook and executive deck.

useCases: Monthly pacing / Current Estimate reporting reviews
Blocking exception triage before Finance approval
dataDisclosure: All figures and entity names in this stack's demo and files/ snapshot are synthetic. The NBCUniversal name identifies a prototype scenario and does not imply endorsement. No customer or production NBCUniversal financial data is included.
